title: Topic 17
japanese_text: 定期テストはマークテスト<u>方式</u>で行われる。早めに解答が終わってのんびり<u>構えて</u>いたが、解答用紙が<u>回収される</u>直前に、誤って<u>重複して</u>マークしている問題を見つけてしまった。
english_translation: Tests are held regularly, using a test-marking format. I had finished answering the questions early and was set to relax, but just before the answer sheets were collected, I found a question that I had accidentally marked in duplicate.
